2607.28968.title: A robust association between LLM use and scientific productivity: Assessing stopping-time selection
2607.28968.paper_summary: Renault, Bergeaud, and Bosquet (hereafter RBB) argue that dating LLM adoption as the first month in which an author's abstract is flagged induces a stopping-time selection that can produce a positive event-study path even when there is no causal effect. Although this mechanism is mathematically possible, it does not constitute proof of a null effect. Recalibrating RBB's own random placebo to the detector's realized flag rate, we show that the measured association stays well above this benchmark, so the artifact is too small to explain the productivity changes. We further re-estimate the association between LLM adoption and productivity with a series of complementary designs in which the timing artifact cannot bias the estimate: a before-and-after comparison that dates adoption in one year and measures output in another, a conservative control group for difference-in-differences, an intensity-based specification that never defines an adoption date, and a rank-based measurement holding the flag rate fixed. A positive productivity association persists across all of these estimates, while the same tests run on pre-ChatGPT placebo data return null effects. The artifact RBB identify is real but bounded, and it does not account for the pattern we report.
2607.28968.paper_summary_zh: 雷諾、貝爾喬和博斯凱（以下簡稱 RBB）主張，將 LLM 採用的日期定義為作者摘要被標記的第一個月份，會產生一種停止時間選擇，這可能會在沒有因果效應的情況下產生正向事件研究路徑。雖然這一機制在數學上是可能的，但並不構成無效應的證明。通過將 RBB 自己的隨機安慰劑重新校準至檢測器的實際標記率，我們顯示測量的關聯性遠高於這一基準，因此這一人為產物過小，無法解釋生產力的變化。我們進一步使用一系列互補設計重新估計 LLM 採用與生產力之間的關聯，其中時間人為產物無法對估計產生偏見：一個前後比較，將採用日期定在一年，並在另一年測量產出，一個保守的控制組用於差異中的差異，一個基於強度的規範，從不定義採用日期，以及一個基於排名的測量，保持標記率不變。正向的生產力關聯在所有這些估計中持續存在，而在 ChatGPT 之前的安慰劑數據上進行的相同測試則返回無效應。RBB 確認的人為產物是真實的，但是有限的，並且無法解釋我們報告的模式。
